blind.description: A stylized ornate wooden library desk or writing table. It features a rectangular top with an inset dark green leather or felt blotter accented with four brass corner pins, a front apron equipped with four shallow drawers with curved brass drop handles, and two carved trestle-style pedestal legs joined near the floor by a sturdy horizontal stretcher beam. Surfaces are completely solid, clean, and continuous, styled with warm brown wood tones and golden metallic hardware.
blind.from_above: A clean rectangular wooden border enclosing a vibrant dark green rectangular inlay with small gold pins near the inner corners, flanked by slightly protruding rectangular corner posts.
blind.height_vs_figure: The desk stands around 2.5 to 3 feet tall (less than half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and measures roughly 5.5 to 6 feet long and 2.5 feet deep.
